discovery_health.diagnosis: The free public discovery chain is now non-zero. PUBLIC_X_AGGREGATOR is currently the highest-yield route, while direct X rendering remains unavailable. Source-cache freshness is now treated as a separate evidence dimension so crawler cache dates are not mistaken for post or metric timestamps.

cohort_definitions.recent: Unique real X status permalinks with published_at sufficient for a 0-48h freshness classification.
cohort_definitions.interaction_observed: Recent posts with at least one labeled public interaction observation or aggregate interaction observation. This cohort is not equivalent to high-view.
cohort_definitions.high_distribution: Posts with verifiable distribution evidence such as views >=10000 under the feed contract. None are fully verified in the current unique sample.
cohort_definitions.control: Ordinary or low-distribution posts matched as closely as possible on author scale, topic and post age. None are available yet.

structure_labels.label: IMMEDIATE_PRODUCT_OR_ACCESS_CHANGE
structure_labels.description: The post gives readers a concrete new capability, access change or immediately usable product update.

structure_labels.label: SPECIFIC_HIGH_STAKES_SAFETY_CLAIM
structure_labels.description: The post centers a concrete model-behavior or control/safety claim with potentially high consequences.

structure_labels.label: CONCRETE_NOUNS_AND_ACTIONS
structure_labels.description: All five excerpts are anchored in a named product, actor, capability or policy action rather than a generic opinion.

candidate_patterns.name: Concrete utility or access change may create a strong reader payoff
candidate_patterns.support: Three of the five fresh unique posts frame a specific capability/access change. They are easy to understand and give the reader an immediate answer to 'what changed for me?'.
candidate_patterns.limitations: All are official or very large AI accounts, there is no matched low-distribution control, and one record has conflicting untimed metrics. This does not establish causality or portability to a Chinese personal account.

candidate_patterns.name: Specific high-stakes claims can create information value without a lifestyle/self-mirroring hook
candidate_patterns.support: Two fresh posts lead with concrete AI safety/control claims. This is useful negative evidence against treating self-mirroring as a necessary condition for attention.
candidate_patterns.limitations: Only Anthropic has labeled interaction observations in the current sample; Satya Nadella's record has no verified reach metric. Author authority is a major confounder.

counterexamples.point: An official Google AI announcement has labeled engagement but materially lower observed likes/reposts than the Anthropic behavior-report post. Being an official AI account and announcing something new is therefore not sufficient by itself to explain stronger interaction.

Conflicting untimed third-party engagement observations show why apparent numeric precision from mirrors can be misleading. The canonical likes/reposts remain null rather than selecting the more convenient snapshot.

confounders: All five fresh unique posts are from globally prominent technology executives or official AI/product accounts; author scale is not controlled.
No matched ordinary/low-distribution control cohort exists yet.
Direct X rendering is blocked in the current environment, so most metrics come from provenance-scoped public aggregators or corroborating sources.
Four of five posts lack verified view counts; interaction observations cannot be equated with total distribution.
Third-party caches can lag and may not expose metric snapshot times. Source freshness is now explicitly gated but older records predate the new source_freshness fields.
The current sample is heavily concentrated in AI/technology, so topic effects cannot be separated from structural effects.
recent_changes: The feed moved from two zero-yield runs to two non-zero runs with five unique recent X status IDs.
PUBLIC_X_AGGREGATOR is currently the highest-yield free discovery route at 4 admissions from 8 bounded queries in the accumulated index.
Source freshness policy was hardened so crawler cache time, source snapshot time, post time and metric time are not silently conflated.
The first fresh structural observations are now recorded, but none are promoted beyond OBSERVATION because controls and verified distribution are missing.
next_sampling_priorities: Collect at least 10-20 more fresh real status IDs before attempting any replicated structural claim.
Deliberately collect ordinary/low-distribution controls from the same or similar authors within similar post-age windows.
Expand beyond AI/official-company accounts into Chinese tech creators, ordinary-person experience, work/money, social observation, reversal/oddity and history/culture buckets.
Prefer sources that expose an exact status permalink plus explicitly labeled metrics and a trustworthy source snapshot time; downgrade generic aggregator pages with stale-cache risk.
Seek verifiable view counts, but do not weaken evidence rules or buy a paid data source to obtain them.
When enough controls exist, test whether immediate reader payoff, specificity, information gap, self-relevance and opinion space predict distribution after controlling author scale and age.
note: The discovery problem is no longer zero-yield. This is the first evidence-backed fresh-sample analysis, but it is intentionally conservative: five unique posts with no matched controls cannot support a viral formula.
